_note: EXAMPLE rules that map the sensors with the biggest deviation to a suggested action. They are plausible starting points, not engineering truth: confirm them with your faculty guide or the dataset paper and edit freely.
default: Review the dashboard around this time and inspect the compressor.

rules.name: pressure
rules.action: Inspect the air circuit and its connections for leaks; compare the pressure readings with the reservoirs and the dryer.

rules.name: oil
rules.action: Check the oil level, the oil condition and the cooling.

rules.name: motor
rules.action: Inspect the motor and the compressor load; look for mechanical wear or a blockage.

rules.name: duty
rules.action: The compressor is cycling differently from normal (running more or less often); check for air leaks and the pressure switches.

rules.name: valves
rules.action: Inspect the valves and the dryer towers.
